verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like Puzzle, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The data-export and light/dark-mode items are unrelated features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
